title: From the Jungle to the Ice Caves
description: The player takes level 8's exit. In the screen between levels, he pays the Tunnel Man the $500 left on a shortcut, and level 9, the first Ice Caves level, loads: blue rock and ice blocks, with Yetis and a UFO.
